channel.title: Among The Letters Opportunities (free list)
channel.description: Writing contests, residencies, fellowships, grants and paid markets, checked against official pages.

item.title: EVENT Magazine, Non-Fiction Contest
item.description: A long-running Canadian creative non-fiction contest, entry includes a one-year subscription and students pay a lower fee. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: PRISM international, General Poetry and Prose Submissions
item.description: PRISM international reads fiction, poetry, creative non-fiction and translation for each issue, with the small fee waived for incarcerated writers. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: The Sun Magazine, Submissions
item.description: A magazine of personal essays, fiction and poetry that welcomes first-time authors and marginalized voices. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Ploughshares, Open Reading Period
item.description: A major literary journal reads fiction, poetry and non-fiction from June 1 to November 15, with a small online submission fee. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: Manitoba Arts Council, Create Grants
item.description: Provincial funding for Manitoba writers to create new work, offered twice a year. Deadline 2027-03-20.

item.title: ArtsNB, Creation Grants
item.description: New Brunswick's arts board funds writers to set time aside for original projects. Deadline 2027-04-01.

item.title: Boa Editions, A. Poulin, Jr. Poetry Prize
item.description: A first-book poetry prize from Boa Editions, read each year from August through November. Deadline 2026-11-30.

item.title: Fine Arts Work Center in Provincetown, Writing Fellowship
item.description: A seven-month fellowship residency in Provincetown, with an access fund of $500 to $2,500 for selected fellows with financial need. Deadline 2026-12-15.

item.title: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity, Spring Writers
item.description: Two weeks in the mountains with weekly faculty consultations, readings and campus events, with financial help available toward the program fee. Deadline 2026-12-09.

item.title: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity, Literary Journalism
item.description: A Banff Centre program for long-form journalism and narrative non-fiction, led by three faculty writers. Deadline 2027-01-13.

item.title: Room Magazine, Fiction Contest
item.description: Annual contests from a Canadian magazine open to women, trans, Two-Spirit and nonbinary writers, with prizes and publication. Next deadline expected around September 2027.

item.title: Virginia Center for the Creative Arts, Residencies and Fellowships
item.description: One of the largest residency programs in the US, with fee waivers on request and fully funded fellowships each round. Deadline 2027-01-15.

item.title: Poetry magazine, Poetry Submissions
item.description: Poetry reads poems and prose year round through Submittable, alongside special open calls. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Strange Horizons, Fiction Submissions
item.description: A weekly speculative fiction magazine recognised as a professional market, reading in seasonal windows. Deadline Fiction opens in windows, the next one opens October 1.

item.title: Asimov's Science Fiction, Writers' Guidelines
item.description: A long-established science fiction magazine that reads short stories year round through its online system. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Analog Science Fiction and Fact, Writers' Guidelines
item.description: A science fiction magazine eager to find and develop new writers, paying on acceptance. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Chicken Soup for the Soul, Story Submissions
item.description: True stories and poems for upcoming themed books, with new topics added through the year. Deadline Each book topic has its own deadline, new topics are added often.

item.title: Grain Magazine, Regular Submissions
item.description: A literary magazine reading year round with a monthly cap, so check back if the month is full. Deadline not stated.

item.title: The Threepenny Review, Submissions
item.description: A literary quarterly with flat rates per story, article and poem, reading from January each year. Deadline Reads from January 1 each year until the spring.

item.title: SmokeLong Quarterly, General Submissions
item.description: A flash fiction quarterly with free submission windows at the start of each reading period. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: The Malahat Review, General Submissions
item.description: A Canadian quarterly that reads Canadian writers for the first half of every year. Deadline 2027-06-30.

item.title: EVENT Magazine, General Submissions
item.description: EVENT reopens to fiction and poetry each December after reaching its caps. Deadline Fiction and poetry reopen December 1 after reaching their caps.

item.title: Geist, General Submissions
item.description: A Canadian magazine of ideas and culture buying short personal narrative, longform essays, fiction and comics. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Yaddo, Artist Residencies
item.description: A century-old artists' retreat offering free stays judged only on the work, with small access grants for travel. Deadline 2026-12-20.

item.title: Commonwealth Foundation, Commonwealth Short Story Prize
item.description: A major international short story prize, open to unpublished fiction in many languages, that reopens in January. Deadline Returns in January 2027 after a review of its rules.

item.title: Hedgebrook, Writer-in-Residence
item.description: A residency for women-identified writers from around the world, where the cottage, meals and whole stay are free and travel is the writer's own. Next deadline expected around April 2027.

item.title: Arts Nova Scotia, Grants to Individuals
item.description: Provincial grants for Nova Scotia writers and artists to create or present new work. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: SK Arts, Independent Artists
item.description: Saskatchewan's main grant for individual writers and artists, with the portal opening weeks before each deadline. Deadline 2027-03-15.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council, Literary Creation Projects
item.description: Ontario's grant for writers creating new books and literary work, one of the main sources of writing funding in the province. Deadline Dates are posted when the program opens in the council's online system.

item.title: Academy of American Poets, First Book Award
item.description: A leading first-book prize for poets, open each summer. Next deadline expected around September 2027.

item.title: Writer's Digest, Annual Writing Competition
item.description: A large multi-category competition covering fiction, poetry, memoir, screenwriting and more. Deadline 2027-05-05.

item.title: The Missouri Review, Jeffrey E. Smith Editors' Prize
item.description: A major literary magazine prize awarding $5,000 each in fiction, non-fiction and poetry. Next deadline expected around October 2027.

item.title: AGNI, Submissions
item.description: A Boston University literary magazine with two reading periods each year and a small reading fee. Deadline 2026-12-15.

item.title: The Georgia Review, General Submissions
item.description: An award-winning quarterly where every submission is read by a published writer on staff. Deadline 2027-05-15.

item.title: CBC Books, CBC Poetry Prize
item.description: A national poetry contest from CBC Books, open each April and May, where being a finalist can jumpstart a career. Deadline 2027-06-01.

item.title: Authors League Fund, Emergency Support for Writers
item.description: Interest-free help with urgent bills for professional writers, with no repayment required. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Bard College, Bard Fiction Prize
item.description: A prize for a promising emerging American fiction writer, with a $30,000 award and a writer in residence appointment at Bard. Deadline Presented each October, check the page for this year's application date.

item.title: University of Pittsburgh Press, Drue Heinz Literature Prize
item.description: A $25,000 prize for a short fiction collection, with publication and worldwide promotion of the winning book. Deadline Annual, check the page for this year's reading dates.

item.title: Bridport Prize, Bridport Prize
item.description: One of the best known international writing competitions, open to writers in North America. Deadline 2027-05-31.

item.title: CBC Books, CBC Nonfiction Prize
item.description: A national non-fiction contest from CBC Books, open each January and February. Deadline 2027-03-01.

item.title: The Poetry Society (UK), National Poetry Competition
item.description: A first prize of £5,000 with publication from the Poetry Society, given annually for a single poem. Second and third prizes of £3,000 and £2,000 are also given. Deadline 2026-10-31.

item.title: Writer’s Digest, Short Short Story Competition
item.description: A prize of $3,000 from Writer’s Digest, given annually for a short short story. Deadline 2026-11-16.

item.title: Academy of American Poets, Treehouse Climate Action Poem Prize
item.description: A prize of $1,000 with publication from the Academy of American Poets, given annually for a poem that helps readers recognize the vulnerable state of our environment. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: Colorado Review, Colorado Prize for Poetry
item.description: A prize of $2,500 with publication from Colorado Review, given annually for a poetry collection. Deadline 2027-01-14.

item.title: Leon Levy Center for Biography, Leon Levy Biography Fellowships
item.description: Yearlong fellowships of $72,000 each, given annually to non-fiction writers working on biographies, with writing space at the CUNY Graduate Center in New York City and research help. Deadline 2027-01-04.

item.title: Brick, Brick Submissions
item.description: Brick pays contributors on publication, with two copies of the issue and a one-year subscription. Deadline not stated.

item.title: League of Canadian Poets, League of Canadian Poets Book Awards
item.description: The Gerald Lampert Memorial Award for a first book, the Pat Lowther Memorial Award and the Raymond Souster Award, each awarded annually in May. Deadline 2026-12-31.

item.title: New York Foundation for the Arts, NYSCA/NYFA Artist Fellowship
item.description: Disciplines rotate by cycle. Fiction is in the 2027 cycle, with applications opening in fall or winter 2026, and poetry and non-fiction literature return in the 2028 cycle. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Artist Trust, Artist Trust Fellowship Awards
item.description: Merit-based awards given annually to Washington artists of any discipline in recognition of artistic excellence. Deadline 2026-11-02.

item.title: Artist Trust, Grants for Artist Projects (GAP)
item.description: Project-based grants for Washington artists, including writers. The 2026 round ran May 18 to June 22. Next deadline expected around June 2027.

item.title: Nebraska Arts Council, Individual Artist Fellowship, Literary Arts
item.description: The 2027 round focuses on the literary arts. The program rotates among literature, film and performing arts, and visual arts. Deadline 2026-11-16.

item.title: Mississippi Arts Commission, Artist Fellowships, Literary Arts
item.description: Literary categories alternate each year. Fiction and poetry were offered for FY2027, with creative non-fiction, screenwriting and playwriting for FY2028. Next deadline expected around March 2027.

item.title: Ontario Library Association, Forest of Reading, Evergreen Award Reading Program for Adults
item.description: Adults read the nominated Canadian titles and vote each September. The 2027 nominees were set to be announced October 29, with the winner named during Ontario Public Library Week. Deadline 2027-09-30.

item.title: OverDrive, Libby Reads Global eBook Club
item.description: A free global ebook club. Readers everywhere borrow the same featured book at the same time, with no wait lists. The current global pick runs November 24 to December 8, 2026. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Toronto Public Library and Library and Archives Canada, TD Summer Reading Club
item.description: A national bilingual summer reading program delivered by over 2,200 public libraries across Canada. Register to track summer reading online. Deadline not stated.

item.title: CBC Books, Canada Reads
item.description: The annual great Canadian book debate. The 2026 edition ran April 13 to 16 with five contending books, and the CBC Books page carries reading lists for each. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Book Riot, Read Harder Challenge
item.description: A yearly challenge to read outside your comfort zone. The 2026 list has 24 tasks, from microhistory to a translated genre book. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Little Free Library, Start a Little Free Library
item.description: Start a neighbourhood book exchange, or use the web map and mobile app to find a little library near you. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Poetry in Voice, Poetry in Voice Recitation Competition
item.description: A national poetry recitation competition for students, with national finals planned for April 17 to 21, 2027. Deadline 2027-03-04.

item.title: National Endowment for the Arts, Poetry Out Loud
item.description: A national poetry recitation competition. Students advance from classroom contests to state finals, with National Finals in Washington, DC on April 27 to 28, 2027. Deadline not stated.

item.title: BC Arts Council, Individual Arts Grants, Creative Writers
item.description: Supports new literary projects for book-length publication or public performance, including graphic novels, spoken word and storytelling. Next deadline expected around October 2027.

item.title: Alberta Foundation for the Arts, Literary Individual Project Funding
item.description: Funding for a distinct phase of a literary project, such as a first or final draft. Translation and anthology projects are also eligible. Deadline 2027-03-01.

item.title: Toronto Arts Council, Writers Program
item.description: Two levels of support for Toronto writers working on a project. Recipients from 2025 may reapply in 2027. Next deadline expected around June 2027.

item.title: Ontario Arts Council, Recommender Grants for Writers
item.description: Writers apply through recommending publishers, up to ten per program year. Recommenders set their own review schedules. Deadline 2027-01-15.

item.title: Winnipeg Arts Council, Individual Artist Grant Program
item.description: Applications open through GoSmart in mid-December 2026, with 2027 guidelines published at the same time. Deadline 2027-03-02.

item.title: Writers’ Trust of Canada, RBC Bronwen Wallace Awards
item.description: Send up to 10 pages of unpublished work. Prose is capped at 2,500 words. All applicants are invited to career development webinars in spring 2027. Deadline 2026-12-01.

item.title: Rattle, Rattle Poetry Prize
item.description: Send up to four poems of any length or style. The $30 fee is a one-year subscription to Rattle. Next deadline expected around July 2027.

item.title: Rattle, Rattle General Submissions
item.description: General and themed submissions are always free. Every submission is also considered for the $2,000 Neil Postman Award for Metaphor. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Uncanny Magazine, Uncanny Magazine Submissions
item.description: Original speculative fiction of 750 to 10,000 words, plus speculative poetry and essays. Uncanny opens in announced windows, so follow its newsletter for reopening news. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Beneath Ceaseless Skies, Beneath Ceaseless Skies Submissions
item.description: Literary adventure fantasy with a secondary-world setting. Every accepted story is line-edited with the author. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Arc Poetry Magazine, Arc Poetry Magazine Submissions
item.description: Arc accepts unsolicited poems from poets at all stages, and offers help with the process to poets living with disabilities or for whom English is difficult. Deadline not stated.

item.title: The Fiddlehead, The Fiddlehead Submissions
item.description: Canadian writers submit free. International writers pay a $5 USD fee, which does not apply to Canadian citizens living abroad. Deadline Reading periods January 1 to 31 and September 15 to October 15.

item.title: Tennessee Arts Commission, Individual Artist Fellowship
item.description: About one to three fellowships in each of seven disciplines, including literary arts. No project or matching funds are required. Deadline 2027-01-15.

item.title: Minnesota State Arts Board, Creative Individuals Grant
item.description: Supports Minnesota artists, including writers. The FY 2027 deadline was March 6, 2026, with awards approved in November. Next deadline expected around March 2027.

item.title: Mass Cultural Council, Grants for Creative Individuals
item.description: About 400 to 500 grants a year, roughly 10 to 15 percent of expected applications. Deadline 2026-10-27.

item.title: Academy of American Poets, Poem-a-Day
item.description: A daily poem published by the Academy of American Poets, with an archive of past poems on the site. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Academy of American Poets, National Poetry Month
item.description: Held every April. The 2026 edition marked the 30th anniversary, with a free virtual benefit reading and the Dear Poet program. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Academy of American Poets, Poem in Your Pocket Day
item.description: A single day during National Poetry Month for carrying a poem and sharing it. The 2026 date was April 30. Deadline not stated.

item.title: Clarkesworld Magazine, Short fiction and non-fiction submissions
item.description: An award-winning monthly magazine open for stories of 1,000 to 22,000 words. Deadline Open now.

item.title: The Walrus, Pitches for features, essays and poetry
item.description: Reported features, long-form journalism and short poems from new and established Canadian writers. Deadline Pitches accepted year-round.

item.title: Canada Council for the Arts, Explore and Create, Artistic Creation
item.description: Funding for creating new work from first idea to public presentation. Deadline Apply any time before your project starts.

item.title: American Academy in Rome, Rome Prize in Literature
item.description: Work alongside artists and scholars in Rome. Self-published books do not establish eligibility. Deadline 2026-11-15.

item.title: CBC Books, 2027 CBC Short Story Prize
item.description: One of the best-known open contests for Canadian fiction, with long and short lists that bring real attention to new names. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: The Malahat Review, Open Season Awards
item.description: Three genres, three winners published in the spring issue. Poetry entries hold up to three poems. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: MASS MoCA, The Studios at MASS MoCA, July to December 2027
item.description: Residencies beside one of the largest contemporary art museums in North America. Free to apply. Deadline 2026-11-01.

item.title: Stanford University, Wallace Stegner Fellowship, 2027 to 2029
item.description: Two years of workshops for poets and fiction writers. A fee waiver request is built into the application. Deadline 2026-11-02.

item.title: Ucross, Fall 2027 Residencies
item.description: Working ranch residencies from August to early December, with dedicated fellowships for Native American writers. Deadline 2027-01-15.

item.title: MacDowell, Fall 2027 to Winter 2028 Fellowships
item.description: One of the most established residencies in North America. The application opens in mid-January. Deadline 2027-02-10.
